value: Deep in the drowned temple, the seeker reaches the Sanctum of the Fallen God. Atal’ai bloodrinkers stand among the threats within its halls; the Mosh’aru tablets and Ancient Egg frame Yeh’kinya’s rite. The deep waters hold their silence as the summoning begins.
editorNote: Original paraphrase. Scene order follows quest-chain order and does not assert exact date or unsupported causal links. Secondary locators and original-client limits are recorded in the research packet.
